page_title: UDI 3-2 LEC | Udinese v Lecce 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' 3 - 2 Konan Ndri (Lecce) controls the ball with an excellent first touch on the edge of the penalty box after receiving a splendid pass and smashes the ball into the top right corner!
90+6' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Lecce players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
90+2' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Ermano Feliciani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Adam Buksa (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
89' 3 - 1 GOAL! Adam Buksa (Udinese) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Wladimiro Falcone, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 3:1.
88' Now Lecce have a corner.
88' Lecce hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
86' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Sala (Lecce) replacing Santiago Pierotti.
86' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Zanoli.
83' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) is able to continue to play.
82' The game is interrupted now, Francesco Camarda (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
78' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Here is a change. Medon Berisha is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Youssef Maleh (Lecce).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jurgen Ekkelenkamp leaves the pitch and Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) comes on.
76' 4:7 – the corner kicks stats.
73' Lecce exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
71' Udinese are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
70' The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Medon Berisha (Lecce) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
68' Nice passing game by Lecce. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
66' Arthur Atta (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Nikola Stulic goes off the pitch and Francesco Camarda (Lecce) comes on.
63' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes.
60' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) replaces Oumar Solet.
60' Substitution. Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nicolo Zaniolo walks off.
59' 2 - 1 Medon Berisha (Lecce) scores from a free kick after smashing the ball over the defensive wall and into the top left corner of the goal!
58' Fouls committed – 9:6.
56' Udinese players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
53' Lecce hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
52' None of the Udinese players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
51' Lecce players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
49' The Lecce players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Substitution. Keinan Davis did his best and is replaced by Adam Buksa (Udinese).
46' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Tete Morente will be replaced by Lameck Banda (Lecce).
46' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Thorir Johann Helgason is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The game is interrupted. Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' The game is interrupted. Keinan Davis (Udinese) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The total number of attempts is 5:5.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Keinan Davis (Udinese) was quite harsh and Ermano Feliciani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

40' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
40' Lecce are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
39' Referee Ermano Feliciani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Udinese players celebrate.
39' The Udinese players halt their celebrations as referee Ermano Feliciani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
37' 2 - 0 Goal! Arthur Atta is the provider and Keinan Davis (Udinese) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 2:0.

36' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
35' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
31' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Medon Berisha (Lecce) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
31' A lofted cross from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
27' Great teamplay by Lecce as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

25' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
23' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

22' Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.

20' What a great touch by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.
19' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Udinese.
16' 1 - 0 Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
16' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' 64:36 – the latest ball possession ratio.
12' The Udinese players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
10' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
9' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
7' Keinan Davis (Udinese) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
6' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. Nikola Stulic (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
3' Udinese hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' A quickly taken corner by Lecce.
1' The first half has just begun.
